parameters.description: A condition, as `field:operator:value`. Repeat the parameter for more than one; they are ANDed, and there is no OR. Split on the first two colons only, so a colon inside a value survives. The field must be a queryable case field and the operator must apply to its kind, or the request is a 400 naming every condition it could not read rather than only the first. Operators: is (takes one value), contains (takes one value), startsWith (takes one value), before (takes one value), after (takes one value), gt (takes one value), lt (takes one value), between (takes two comma-separated values, low first), isOneOf (takes at least one comma-separated value), isEmpty (takes no value), isNotEmpty (takes no value).
parameters.name: where

parameters.description: A search term. Matched against the case reference exactly -- tolerant of case, hyphens and spaces, so `kbdp2026-10100` and `KBDP202610100` find the same case -- or as a case-insensitive substring of newForename, newSurname, oldForename, oldSurname, parents, representativeName. Those two are ORed, and the result is ANDed with `filter` and every `where` condition. Matching is substring and not fuzzy: a misspelling does not match. Addresses and narrative fields are deliberately not searched. Longer than 100 characters is truncated rather than refused. Where the term matched one case's reference exactly, the response's `referenceMatch` carries that case's id.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: An order, as `field:asc|desc`. The direction may be omitted and defaults to ascending. Sortable fields are the columns the list shows: referencenumber, displayReference, dateOfApplication, inPerson, postCounter, feeReference, dateReceived, type, maritalStatus, minorDateOfBirth, ageOfMinor, ageOfMinorMonths, parents, privacy, state, currentReferralState, urgency, urgencyreason, onlineApplicationReference, retainPermanently, awaitingFurtherDocsInfo, newForename, newMiddleName, newSurname, oldForename, oldMiddleName, oldSurname, applicantBuildingNoName, applicantAddress1, applicantAddress2, applicantTownCity, applicantPostcode, applicantEmail, applicantTelephone, representativeName, representativeCompany, representativeEmail, representativeTelephone, representativeBuildingNoName, representativeAddress1, representativeAddress2, representativeTownCity, representativePostcode, nationality, nationalitySection, nationalitySectionOther, dateOfDeclaration, referToMasterChoice, dateReadyForMaster, dateReferred, referralNotes, masterName, masterDirections, masterDecision, masterDateOfDecision, dateDecisionDirectionsReceived, publishToLondonGazette, signatureRequestedDate, signatureReceivedDate, dateEnroled, dateNoticeSentToLondonGazette, dateReturned, returnReason, refundAmount, dateOfRefund, refundReference, createdOn, modifiedOn, createdBy, modifiedBy. Defaults to newest first.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: The page to return, 1-based. Defaults to 1.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many rows on the page. Defaults to 25 and is capped at 100: a larger value is clamped to the cap rather than refused, because an unbounded list is a denial of service against the service's own database.
parameters.name: size

direction.description: Whether the document was received or sent. Optional.

documentTypeId.description: The document type this file is filed under. Must be an existing type, or 404. A type's applicability to the case's marital status and deed poll type is advisory -- it is what a form filters its options by, and the service does not enforce it.

file.description: The file. A PDF, image or Word document, within the configured size limit.

name.description: An optional display name. Defaults to the uploaded filename, capped to the column.

requestBody.description: The file and the document row to record against it.

CreateCaseRequest.description: Every field is optional: a case is logged incrementally. An omitted field is left alone and an explicit null clears the column, where the column is nullable. Unknown keys are ignored. dateReceived is needed to allocate a reference number, so a create without it is a 400 attributed to that field.

CreateNoteRequest.description: The note text. Trimmed before validation, and the trimmed value is what is stored. The author comes from the caller's token and the case from the path, so neither can be set here. Unknown keys are ignored.

CreateReferralRequest.description: A referral of the case to the judiciary, raised unclaimed into the shared pool. reasons is the only field required outright; notes is required when Other is among them, and urgencyReason when urgency is Urgent. The case comes from the path, the state is always Open, and there is no target judge -- who picks a referral up is a later transition -- so state, migrated and any assignee are ignored rather than refused, as any unknown key is. A case may hold many referrals over its lifetime but only one that is not closed or withdrawn, so a second live referral is a 409 rather than a 400.

notes.description: The single free-text field: the explanation Other requires and the general referral note at once, rather than two near-identical fields. Trimmed, and a whitespace-only value counts as none.

reasons.description: Why the case is being referred. At least one, de-duplicated, and stored in the order they are sent. Other requires notes.

items.description: Matched exactly, as the stored form is the wire form.

urgency.description: The referral's own urgency, separate from the case's and defaulting to Normal. Matched exactly: an unknown value is refused rather than read as Normal, because that would drop the one signal that gets a referral looked at.

urgencyReason.description: Why the referral jumped the queue. Required when urgency is Urgent.

CreateSavedQueryRequest.description: A saved case-list query. Only name is required: a query that narrows nothing is legitimate, because "everything, newest first" is a view somebody wants a tab for. The owner comes from the caller's token, so ownerId cannot be set here, and page is not part of a view -- both are ignored rather than refused, as any unknown key is. Saving does not select: the new query is in the library and in nobody's list, including its owner's.

conditions.description: The where conditions as the wire strings a list URL carried -- "field:operator:value", split on the first two colons -- and NOT structured objects. Validated on write by the same parser a live query goes through, so a saved query round-trips a list URL unchanged.

filter.description: Which case-list filter tab the view opens on.

name.description: What the query is called, as it appears in a navigation bar.

searchTerm.description: The q search term this view carries, matched against the reference and the name columns. page is deliberately not stored: page 4 of a previous result set is not a page of this one.

shared.description: Whether the query is published to the library every caseworker can browse. Publishing makes it findable, not present in anyone else's list -- each user selects what they want to see. A shared query may also be amended or deleted by an Administrator.

sortDirection.description: Matched exactly: asc, desc. A bare sortField with no direction is read as ascending.

sortField.description: The field to order by. Any of CaseSort.sortableFields() -- the single-valued form fields plus the audit columns -- which is not enumerated here because there are more than sixty and a frozen copy would drift.

CreateWitnessRequest.description: A witness or declarant. All four fields are required: every column is NOT NULL. declarant must be a JSON boolean -- the string "true" is refused rather than coerced. Values are stored as submitted and not trimmed. The case comes from the path and no author is recorded, so neither can be set here. Unknown keys are ignored.

declarant.description: Whether this witness is the declarant. One row type covers both.

witnessAddress.description: The whole address as one free-text field, exactly as the source form holds it.

JudicialDirectionRequest.description: The holding judge's direction on a referral, recorded once and complete -- there is no draft and no patch, because the check-your-answers page and the attestation are the admin's. Permitted only on a referral this caller currently holds, so a referral withdrawn under them or taken back by the inactivity sweep is a 409 rather than a late direction on a referral that moved on. The referral comes from the path and the case is resolved from it -- a judicial URL carries no case id -- and the state, decidedBy and decisionDate come from the transition, the token and the clock, so all of them are ignored rather than refused, as any unknown key is.

decision.description: What the judge decided. Matched exactly, as the stored form is the wire form.

directionsText.description: What the judge directed. Optional: an approval that needs no comment is a real answer. Trimmed, and a whitespace-only value counts as none.

publishToGazette.description: Whether the change is to be published in the London Gazette. The judge's decision, never derived from a caseworker's referral reasons. A JSON boolean -- the string "false" is refused rather than coerced, because publication cannot be taken back.

UpdateCaseRequest.description: A patch: an omitted field is left alone, an explicit null clears the column where the column is nullable, and unknown keys are ignored. referencenumber, displayReference and the audit columns are not writable. privacy is honoured only for a caller entitled to set it, and state is re-derived from the merged dates.

UpdateNoteRequest.description: An empty patch is accepted and re-stamps modifiedBy. An explicit null for note is a 400, not a clear: the column is NOT NULL. Unknown keys are ignored.

UpdateSavedQueryRequest.description: A patch. An omitted field is left as stored, and an explicit null clears the column -- unlike the note and witness patches, where no column is nullable and a null is a 400. name cannot be cleared. An empty patch is accepted and re-stamps modifiedOn. Editing is the owner's right, or an Administrator's if the query is shared. Unknown keys are ignored.

conditions.description: The where conditions as the wire strings a list URL carried -- "field:operator:value", split on the first two colons -- and NOT structured objects. Validated on write by the same parser a live query goes through, so a saved query round-trips a list URL unchanged.

filter.description: Which case-list filter tab the view opens on.

name.description: What the query is called, as it appears in a navigation bar.

searchTerm.description: The q search term this view carries, matched against the reference and the name columns. page is deliberately not stored: page 4 of a previous result set is not a page of this one.

shared.description: Whether the query is published to the library every caseworker can browse. Publishing makes it findable, not present in anyone else's list -- each user selects what they want to see. A shared query may also be amended or deleted by an Administrator.

sortDirection.description: Matched exactly: asc, desc. A bare sortField with no direction is read as ascending.

sortField.description: The field to order by. Any of CaseSort.sortableFields() -- the single-valued form fields plus the audit columns -- which is not enumerated here because there are more than sixty and a frozen copy would drift.

UpdateWitnessRequest.description: A patch. An omitted field is left as stored; a field that is present gets the create rule. An empty patch is accepted and re-stamps modifiedOn. An explicit null is a 400, not a clear: every column is NOT NULL. Unknown keys are ignored.

declarant.description: Whether this witness is the declarant. One row type covers both.

witnessAddress.description: The whole address as one free-text field, exactly as the source form holds it.
